components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      properties:
        firstName:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
            The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+' (e.g. '0412 345 678'
            is stored as '+61412345678'); the stored and returned value is that
            E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it

            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'

## Summary

I implemented the `customerCode` assignment for owners, formatted `<LAST3>-<NNNN>`.

**What the rule does:** When an owner is created via `POST /api/owners`, they're assigned a `customerCode` where `LAST3` is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and `NNNN` is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the current number of owners (e.g. `SMI-0007`).

**Changes made:**

1. **`Owner.java`** (model) — added a persisted `customer_code` column with getter/setter.

2. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — in `addOwner`, assign the code just before saving via a new `nextCustomerCode(lastName)` helper that computes `LAST3` and sequence = `clinicService.findAllOwners().size() + 1`, formatted with `String.format("%s-%04d", ...)`. The count is read before the save, so each successive owner gets a consecutive number.

3. **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `customerCode` property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field and MapStruct maps it automatically onto the `GET /api/owners/{id}` response.

4. **Schema DDL** — added the `customer_code` column to the `owners` table in all four dialects (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres); the test profile uses hsqldb with `ddl-auto=none`, so the schema change was required for the field to persist.

The `coreFormatAndGlobalSequence` acceptance test passes (verifying the `SMI-`/`JON-` prefixes and the consecutive global sequence), along with the entire existing suite.
